description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the job instances that can benefit from the specified table in the selected analysis batch and the estimated shuffle data volume that can be saved for each instance
description_zh: 分页查询指定表在所选分析批次中可受益的作业实例及各实例预估可节省的 Shuffle 数据量
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute list-auto-cluster-suggestion-job-info --project analytics_prod --table order_detail --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAutoClusterSuggestionJobInfo

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute table
parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en: The date of the analysis batch in the yyyyMMdd format. If this parameter is not specified, the latest batch of the corresponding dataset is used
parameters.help_zh: 分析批次日期，格式为 yyyyMMdd。不传时使用对应数据集的最新批次
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
parameters.help_zh: 表所属的 Schema 名称
parameters.name: schema

data.description_en: The results of listing the jobs associated with automatic clustering suggestions for the table
data.description_zh: 列出表的自动聚簇建议关联作业的结果

autoClusterJobList.description_en: The list of job benefit records on the current page
autoClusterJobList.description_zh: 本页的作业收益记录列表

extNodeId.description_en: The ID of the external scheduling node associated with the job

savedShuffle.description_en: The estimated amount of shuffle data that can be saved by the instance, in GB
